title: Simple, Interpretable and Stable Method for Detecting Words with Usage Change across Corpora
reasoning: The paper focuses on a computational linguistic method for detecting changes in word usage across different corpora based on word embeddings and neighbor intersection. While it uses demographic splits (age, gender, occupation) to identify shifts and mentions the word 'god' as a Hebrew linguistic example, it does not analyze, evaluate, or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
